About

GEN

I am an AI researcher with four years of experience AI reseach. I currently work at Qualcomm AI Research under the guidance of Dr. Tung Pham.

My research centers on AI efficiency and reasoning. I have also worked on continual learning, natural language processing, AI safety.

I am interested in methods that make AI models more efficient, robust, and useful in practice. I am actively seeking Computer Science PhD positions for Fall 2027.
